status: prospective learned-verifier neural bridge locked before GPU outcomes; pilot external-validity study, negative/null/underpowered outcomes retained

learned_verifier.representation: mean pooled final-layer causal-LM hidden states over response tokens

arms.fresh: neural verifier trained on post-shift current-policy verifier-fit rollouts
arms.stale: same neural architecture trained on pre-shift verifier-fit rollouts and scored with the pre-shift backbone
arms.shuffled: fresh verifier scores deterministically permuted within each prompt, preserving per-prompt score multiset

stale_inducing_policy_shift.snapshot_rule: post-shift model/optimizer/RNG state becomes the common policy snapshot for all verifier arms
stale_inducing_policy_shift.underpowered_if: sampled post-shift-vs-pre-shift token k3 on the current effect bank is non-finite or exactly zero

pre_update_measurements: Cov(y,v) over current effect candidate occurrences
sampled current-vs-pre-shift policy KL on current effect candidates
sampled current-vs-pre-shift k3 and max absolute log-ratio
secondary: within-prompt/between-prompt covariance decomposition and Cov(y, group-normalized GRPO advantage)

drift_calibration.metric: post-update mean token k3 on the fixed current-policy LR calibration rollout bank
drift_calibration.selection_rule: evaluate every LR for all four verifier arms from the exact same post-shift model/optimizer/RNG snapshot; target=0.8*minimum arm-specific maximum positive finite calibration k3; choose each arm LR minimizing absolute log-distance to target, ties to smaller LR

effect_update: restore the common post-shift snapshot and apply exactly one GRPO update per arm to identical current-policy effect rollout identities using only that arm reward

terminal_evaluation.candidate_bank: generated once from the common post-shift policy before any arm effect update and never used for LR selection or gradients
terminal_evaluation.correctness_access: not read until all four arm LR choices, effect updates, candidate-logprob collection and terminal greedy generations are fixed
terminal_evaluation.metric: change from common post-shift baseline in per-prompt mean sequence logprob(correct candidates)-mean sequence logprob(incorrect candidates)

primary_analysis.eligibility: verifier fit eligibility for stale and fresh; at least 3 informative terminal prompts; max/min realized effect-update k3 across four arms <=1.5
primary_analysis.estimand: within each eligible seed, Spearman rank correlation across the four arms between pre-update Cov(y,v) and trusted terminal preference shift
primary_analysis.comparator: within-seed Spearman rank correlation between realized effect-update k3 and trusted terminal preference shift
primary_analysis.directional_prediction: mean verifier-geometry rank correlation across at least 2 eligible seeds is positive and exceeds mean k3 rank correlation

secondary_analysis: fresh vs stale verifier holdout Brier/ECE/ranking accuracy on current-policy candidates
oracle/fresh/stale/shuffled terminal greedy GSM8K exact match
pairwise sign consistency between differences in Cov(y,v) and differences in trusted preference shift
effect-update gradient norm, behavior KL estimate, k3 and max log-ratio
compare locked pooled Cov(y,v) with within-prompt Cov(y,v) and Cov(y,GRPO advantage) without changing the primary estimand
no_success_only_substitution: Do not change model, rows, precision, seeds, head architecture/training, shift update, LR grid, arms, eligibility or endpoint after inspecting GPU outcomes. Retain negative/null/underpowered/failure evidence.
scope: single-GPU 0.5B learned-neural-verifier pilot using a frozen-at-version Qwen representation plus trained MLP reward head; not an end-to-end reward-model fine-tune and not frontier-scale evidence

optimizer_aligned_geometry_diagnostic.status: secondary diagnostic locked before any Issue #43 GPU trigger/outcome; primary pooled-Cov(y,v) analysis remains unchanged
optimizer_aligned_geometry_diagnostic.rationale: HFCausalLMGRPOTrainer centers and standardizes reward within each prompt before the surrogate update, so between-prompt verifier calibration can affect pooled Cov(y,v) while being invisible to the GRPO advantage
optimizer_aligned_geometry_diagnostic.advantage_definition: per prompt: a=clip((v-mean(v))/sqrt(mean((v-mean(v))^2)+advantage_eps), -clip_advantage, +clip_advantage), using the instantiated pinned trainer config
metrics: per-prompt trusted/score means, score variance and covariance diagnostics
optimizer_aligned_geometry_diagnostic.selection_use: none; not used for LR selection, eligibility, arm selection, or the locked primary directional prediction
optimizer_aligned_geometry_diagnostic.interpretation: diagnostic for whether pooled verifier geometry agrees with the reward geometry actually exposed to group-normalized GRPO
